tei:div.tei:p: (1) ༄/ rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i tshogs sgrub bya ba'i 'don 'grigs bde chen nyi ma stong 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (2)

na mo gu ru wā gin+d+ra shrī bha dra ye/ sde gsum klong dgu'i shing rta klong chen pa// mdo sgyu'i srog shing kun bzang shes rab rje// thams cad mkhyen pa kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling*// rgyal ba yab sras gsum gyis shis pa stsol// 'dir rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i bka' lung gis karma chos dpal bzang pos klong chen snying thig thugs nyams su bzhes/ 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu las 'gyur med nges don bstan 'dzin dang 'jigs med rang grol gnyis kyis zhus/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po las pad+ma mdo sngags bstan 'dzin dang klong chen 'od gsal nam mkha'i rdo rje gnyis kyis gsan te thugs dam thams cad kyi mthar thug tu mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs te sgrub pa sde drug gi tshogs sgrub bya ba'i tshul la/ thog mar/ bdag bskyed la sman rag gtor gsum/ nyer spyod sbreng tshar/ sa stegs la dkar gtor gnyis/ gser skyems nyer spyod dkar gtor bsham/ dbang phur/ rgyal tho bzhi la dkar gtor re/ dam sri mnan ling*/ skyer phur/ ro g.yam ri gling rgya gram bris pa/ sgo byang*/ dmar gtor gcig ma traṃ gzugs/ chag chag thig skud/ rdul tshon sogs 'du bya/ cho ga dngos la/ sems bskyed sdom chog/ tshig bdun/ sku gsum/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i/ brgyud 'debs/ kun bzang yab yum= rol mo byin rlabs bsdus pa/ rag gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pa'i gshin rje (3)la/ phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i= rta mgrin la/ dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i= yang dag la/ dpal chen he ru ka'i= phur pa la/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i= dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa ma dzāḥ hūm̐: bde gshegs yongs rdzogs= sogs nas/ skyabs su mchiḥ bar lan gsum/ hūm̐ḥ chos kyi dbyings la= nas/ sems skyed doḥ bar lan gsum/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon= nas/ chen por bsngoḥ

bar lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ dung chen/ thing gsum/ zil/ sum gnyis 'jog med kyis/ hūm̐ḥ rang byung rig pa= nas/ yongs gyur 'bru'i he ru kaḥ bar/ phyag rgya rgyas pa nas/ che mchog badz+ra thod phreng= nas/ gnam zhal yum mchog kun bzang sbyoraḥ bar/ las byang gi/ g.yas pas gtso 'khyud= nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ lhug 'don/ khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grubaḥ bar/ phyag rgya rgyas pa nas/ bskal pa'i me ltar/ nas/ da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar/ las byang gi shar lhor bla med= nas/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsalaḥ bar ro/ gshin rje la/ 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi/ āḥ rang bzhin mi gnas= nas/ mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rdzogasaḥ bar ro/ rta mgrin la/ las byang gi (4) hūm̐ḥ rang byung rig pa= nas/ bskal me 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i klongaḥ bar/ khams gsum rol pa las/ 'og min gsang chen= nas/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsalaḥ bar ro/ yan lag las byang gi hūm̐/ rang byung rig pa= nas/ bskal me 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i klong : bar sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ 'og min gsang chen= nas/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por lam gyis gsalaḥ bar ro/ phur pa la/ rdo rje de bzhin nyid kyi= nas/ raḥlas rak+ta sum̐ḥlas zhing chen gzhiḥ las byang gi keṃ las rus pa'i= nas/ bskal me 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i klongaḥ bar bdud dpung zil gnon gyi/ 'og min gsang chen= nas/ zhe la brnag pa'i stobs kyis sgrolaḥ dung chen/ sum gcig zil/ bzhag rol/ bzlas dmigs/ bdag nyid che mchog= nas/ sangs rgyas gyuraḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ ye shes rgyal lo= nas/ shin tu phra zhig 'od zer 'baraḥ oṃ gu ru shṝ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha tsit+ta hūm̐: rang rang sngags kyi= nas/ kun kyang dpal chen go 'phang laḥbakodaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ brgya/ lha tshogs kun gyi= nas/ rig 'dzin bzhi yi gnas thob gyuraḥ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da hā pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ brgya/

skad gcig gnam lcags= nas/ (5) oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha sarba duṣ+ṭan ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhi shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: drag sngags so lnga bcas so/ gshin rje la/ ya ma'i thugs kar= nas/ mi 'gyur rtsa ba'i snying por bshad: bar dang*/ e ka ya ma he duṃ snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: stong phrag gcig go rta mgrin la/ thugs kar rgyal ba= nas/ dzaḥni khyi brgyad rngams pa'i tshogs: oṃ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ e a ral+li hūm̐ hrī dzaḥ stong gcig bzla/ yang dag la/ hūṃḥ dpal chen badz+ra/ nas/ dngos grub mchog gi gter du gyuraḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūm̐ḥ stong phrag bzla'o/ phur pa la/ hūm̐: thugs ka dpal gyi= nas/ phaṭaḥkyis sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ stong phrag bzla/ de nas las byang gi/ hūm̐ḥ snod bcud lha= nas/ gshis su aḥ bar dang*/ slar yang rig pa= nas/ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ḥ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya= ma nu pā la yaḥ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha= nas/ he ru ka ma me muñtsaḥ he ru ka bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar gyis bsdu ldang bya/ de nas (6) cha gsum gtang*/ sa chog ni/ las byang gi mchod rlabs/ hūm̐ḥ dbyings nas ye shes= nas/ pū dza āḥhūm̐ḥ zhi rol thams cad la/ dkar/ rgya/ dung gtang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ a ka ro= lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor= nas/ dril nyis rdung gis/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ zhi rol gyis gzhi bdag gtor ma dang gser skyems phyir 'bul/ sgrub khog gi bdag nyid yi dam= nas/ sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ bsdu rgya/ sa yi lha mo= nas/ spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang rgya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum mkha' lding rgya/ oṃ pri thi dā+e wi sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swa hāḥ

rang rgya bcas/ puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da= zhi rol/ oṃ pri thī de wi sa pā ri wā ra a ka ro= lan gsum/ yo ga bzhi dril gyis/ skyob pa sangs rgyas= nas/ gnang ba byin par gyur/ zhi rol/ badz+ra muṃḥ slob dpon dkyil 'khor mdun du bzhugs nas dbang phur bzung la/ bdag nyid yi dam= nas/ skur gyur/ hūṃ pad+man+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭaḥ phur bu las 'phros pa'i= nas/ dbang du gyur/ dkyil 'khor dbus su gdab/ lag pa g.yas pa'i= nas/ lnga par gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: lan gsum/ lag g.yas par bzhag rdo rje las byung ba'i nas/ oṃ bhu (7)khaṃḥ sa phyogs thams cad= nas/ rang bzhin du gyur/ slob dpon bzhengs te/ rang nyid yi dam= nas/ ra ros par gyuraḥ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ su r+ya tsan+d+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan mang rjod/ khro bcu'i stangs stabs tshig bstun tho ba phur bu thogs nas/ (Musical Notes and Signs here) hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ mkha' dbus lag mthil sbyar te sgrengs// rkang pa brkyang bskum dor stabs mdzod// rdo rje'i stangs stabs gang nyid kyis// gom pa legs par 'jog byed pa// rdo rje'i hūm̐ gi phyag rgya yin// oṃ a badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ bar chad 'byung po gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ shes rab kyi ni rkang pa yis// thabs la rnam par 'khyud pa ni// lag gis rdo rjes gar byed cing*// rdo rje thal mo brdab pa ni// rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya yin// oṃ a badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ḥ bar chad 'byung po ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ las rnams kun la gsod par brtson// thabs kyi sbom po tha ma'i cha// de yi dbus nas srid du rkyong*// rdo rje dbyug pa'i phyag rgya yin// oṃ a badz+ra kro dha ni la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ḥ bar chad 'byung po da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ g.yas pa nas ni phan tshun teḥ /sor mo bsdus pas dbus gnas pa// kun tu (8) bsdus pa rdeg pa'i thabs// gzhan ni yum gyi ngos bzhag ste// dbu ma'i tshad du 'gying ba ste// dpa' bo rngam pa'i phyag rgya yin// oṃ a badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ḥ

bar chad 'byung po pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa// shes rab kyis ni bsgrub bya 'dzin// thabs kyis cod paṇa gdengs par byed// rnam par brtag pa chen po ni// mi g.yo rgyal po'i phyag rgya yin// oṃ a badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐ḥ bar chad 'byung po bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ thal mo mnyam par sbyar nas ni// gung mos 'du byed sgrub par bya// mthe bong dpral ba'i steng du bzhag /rta yi rgyal po gdengs pa'i rgya// oṃ a badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hūṃḥ bar chad 'byung po hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa// ling gting pas mnan pas kyang*// lha chen rang bzhin 'dus par bya// thal mo mnyam gnas dbus su yang*// gsang ba'i dbang po lta na'o// /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya yin/ oṃ a badz+ra kro dha a pa ra tsit+ta hūm̐ḥ bar chad 'byung po tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lag gnyis rdo rje dbus bstan te// rkang gnyis bshibs te drag tu mchong*// 'jigs pa'i rang bzhin rnams btags pa// bdud rtsi 'khyil (9)pa'i phyag rgya yin// oṃ a badz+ra kro dha a mrita kun+ḍa lī hūm̐ḥ bar chad 'byung po tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ nam mkha' rdo rje dbus gnas su// 'bar ba nyi dkyil stong na 'gying*// rdo rje 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis bzhag /dpa' bo the tshom med pa'i rgya// oṃ a badz+ra kro dha trai lokya bi dza ye hūm̐ḥ bar chad 'byung pobhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ thur du rkang mthil mnyam gnas shing*// lag pa so sor gar la brtson// stobs chen mchong ba'i nga rgyal ni// rdo rje stobs kyi phyag rgya yin// oṃ a badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ḥ bar chad 'byung po s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ khro bo'i tshogs slar 'dus nas khro bo 'khyil ba'i rang bzhin gyis rdo rje'i gur khang chen por gyur/ (Musical notes and signs here) zhes pa phur bu rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las so// sngags dang bstun nas khro bcu'i phur pa so sor gdab/

de nas rgyal tho ni/ ser sbreng gis shar tho'i mdun nas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros ri rab kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang rgya/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa hūm̐ dzaḥ lan bdun/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ= dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ thing gcig zil/ 'jog rol/ oṃ (10)dh+riṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa hūm̐ dzaḥ sa pā ri wā ra a kā ro= lan gsum/ thing gcig (Musical Notes and Signs here) hūm̐/ ri rab gling bzhi'i shar= nas/ rgyal tho'i gdangs/ mtshams chod cig / zil/ 'jog rol/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ lho'i tho rtsar/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ be ru dha ka hūm̐ dzaḥ lan bdun/ oṃ be ru dha kā sa pā ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ= theng gcig zil/ bzhag rol/ oṃ be ru dha ka hūm̐ dza sa pā ri wā ra a kā ro= lan gsum/ thing gcig hūṃ/ ri rab gling bzhi'i lho= nas/ mtshams chod cig zil/ 'jog rol/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ nub kyi rtsar/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros ri rab kyi nub phyogs rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ be ru pak+ṣa hūm̐ dzaḥ lan bdun/ oṃ bi ru pak+ṣa sa pā ri wā ra aghaṃ= thing gcig zil/ 'jog rol/ oṃ bi ru pak+ṣa sa pā ri wa ra a kā ro= lan gsum/ thing*/ hūm̐/ ri rab gling bzhi'i nub= nas/ chod cig sil/ 11) bzhag tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ byang gi tho rtsar/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs nas 'od zer 'phros ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ be shra ma ṇa hūm̐ dzaḥ lan bdun/ oṃ be shra ma ṇa sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ= thing gcig zil/ 'jog rol/ oṃ be shra ma ṇa hūm̐ dza sa pā ri wā ra a ka ro=

lan gsum/ thing gcig hūm̐/ ri rab gling bzhi'i byang= nas/ chod cig zil/ 'jog rol/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ sgo drung mnan dong du ling ga bting*/ gser skyems ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ gser skyems zag pa med pa= nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ thing gsum/ zil/ thing*/ thang*/ thing*/ thang*/ hūṃ/ ngo*/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= nas/ khyad par sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed// rnga gong ltar*/ ma mgon lcam dral nas/ sho lo ka rnga gong ltar/ sngags 'chang bdag gi= nas/ mthu dpung skyed// zil 'jog rol/ (Musical notes and signs here) na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma= khyad par drag po dpal chen 'dus pa'i= da dgra nas/ 'gugs rol bcas (12) lan gsum gyis tha ma'i/ (Musical notes and signs here) ham̐'u/ chos kyi dbyings nas= nas/ phur thun tshom bskul/ gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs/ (Musical notes and signs here) ār+ya a tsa la dam sri bhan+dha bhan+dha mā ra ya hūm̐ phraṭaḥ lan grangs rjod/ sa chu me rlung rim pa bcu gsum/ ro g.yam gling bzhi rgya gram bcas pas mnan/ bzhag rol/ bro mnan spros na 'og gi ma traṃ sgrol ba'i skabs su byung ba bzhin/ 'dir blang ba ni/ sum bha ni= bro ra zlum por skor/ srin lag lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ bro mnan rang gdangs/ hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi= nas/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ sum bha ni= nas/ bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dkrol/ sum bha ni= slob dpon shar/ mdzub mo sbrel/ bro rwa zlum por/ shar phyogs zhi ba'i bro brdungs pas/ /nas/ shān+tiṃ swa hāḥ sum bha= dkrol/ sum bha= slob dpon lho/ gung mo sbrel/ bro rwa gru bzhi/ lho phyogs rgyas pa'i bro brdungs pas// nas/ hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ḥ puṣ+ṭiṃ swahāḥ sum bha= dkrol/ sum bha= slob dpon nub/ srin lag sbrel/ bro rwa zla gam/ nub phyogs dbang gi bro brdungs pas/

/nas/ hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ḥ pa shaṃ swa hāḥ sum bha/ dkrol/ sum bha= slob dpon byang*/ lag g.yon steng mas mthe'u chung sbrel/ bro ra gru gsum/ byang phyogs drag po'i bro brdungs pas/ /nas/ hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭaḥ sum (13)bha ni= dkrol/ bsdu na/ sum bha ni/ srin lag sbrel ba'i gro ra zlum pos/ las byang bro mnan/ sum bha nis dkrol bas 'thus/ rdo rje mtshams pas me thun chu thun brab/ sgo byang ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ=

thing gcig zil bzhag kro dha ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra a kā ro= lan gsum/ thing gcig hūṃ/ lha srin sde brgyad= nas/ ma btang cig /zil bzhag (Musical notes and signs here) tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ nang du log zhor/ sgo drung du ling ga la phur pa gdab cing*/ sgo 'di yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig rjod/ tshogs grol/ yar tshogs nas/ rgyal tshab kyis ma tram gtong thun bshad/ de nas zhwa bcas/ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru kony+ra haṃḥ bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo'i skur gyur/ thing gsum/ zil/ sum gnyis 'jog med kyis/ hūm̐: byang chub mchog tu= nas/ myong bar gyis/ sum gcig ma traṃ ka ru tra dzaḥ zil bzhag na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi= nas/ khyad par drag po dpal chen 'dus pa'i= bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i= nas/ a kar+ṣa dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'gugs rol/ (Musical notes and signs here) sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ snying rjes khyod bsgral= nas/ phaṭaḥ sum gcig zil bzhag dkyil 'khor du bro rwa zlum po srin lag sbrel mas/ hūm̐ḥ stong (14) gsum stong gi= nas/ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ bar/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor mdun gzhan rnams gral du 'khod/ bdag gi thugs ka= nas/ bskor bar gyur/ hūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ rgya dkrol/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor lan gsum skor/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha na ha na/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ (Musical notes and signs here) dkyil 'khor dbus su slob dpon bzhengs/ thing gsum/ zil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med kyis/ hūm̐ḥ bdag nyid zhe sdang= nas/ e hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar/ sum gcig zil/ bzhag rol/ zhwa phud/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta maṇ+ḍā la hūm̐ḥ oṃ rak+ta maṇ+ḍā la hūm̐ḥ oṃ kaṃ ka pā la maṇ+ḍā la hūm̐ḥ zhi rol/ chag chag g.yon bskor/ lha sta gon ni/ lha sngags rjod bzhin pas/ dpal chen 'dus pa la/ dbus/ shar lho nub byang/ mtshams bzhi/ sgo bzhi bcas 'khod/ gshin rje la/

dbus phyogs mtshams bdun/ de rgyab bcu gnyis/ de rgyab bcu drug sgo bzhi bcas/ rta mgrin la/ dbus de rgyab bcu drug de rgyab so gnyis/ de rgyab brgyad/ de rgyab brgyad/ sgo bzhi bcas/ yang dag la/ dbus/ de rgyab brgyad/ phur pa la/ dbus/ de rgyab lnga/ de rgyab phyogs bcur/ dbus mdun g.yas g.yon bzhi re ste khyon bzhi bcu/ sgo bzhi/ de rgyab bcu gnyis bcas/ sman rag gtor gsum/ nyer spyod bskor bsham/ de nas las byang gi mchod rlob/ hūm̐ḥ dbyings nas yi ge= nas/ shab+da/ zhi rol/ sman gtor rak+ta'i sngags gsum re/ thing gsum/zil/ sum gnyis/ (15) 'jog med kyis/ dpal chen 'dus par/ hūm̐: rang byung rig pa= nas/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsal: gshin rje la/ āḥ rang bzhin mi gnas= nas/ mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rdzogs: rta mgrin la/ hūm̐: rang byung rig pa= nas/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsal: yang dag la/ hūm̐ḥ rang byung rig pa= nas/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsal: phur pa la/ rdo rje de bzhin nyid kyi= nas/ zhe la brnag pa'i stobs kyis sgrol: bar/ las byang dang sbrel lugs sngar bdag skyed skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ de nas/ dbang bskur/ dpal chen/ gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ yan lag bzhi la las byang gi hūm̐ḥ rang las shar ba'i= nas/ lhug 'don gyis/ rang gi spyi bor= nas/ kā ya= wākā= tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma kony+rahaṃḥ dpal chen gzhung dang*/ yan lag gnyis la/ ye shes lnga'i sngags rang gnas/ gshin rje la/ a dar+sha= shu n+ye ta= sa man+ta= pra te bek+ṣa na= kṛ te nuṣ+ṭha na= sbyar/ rta mgrin la/ pra te bek+ṣa na= a dar+sha= sa man+ta= shu n+ya ta= kṛ te nuṣ+ṭha na= bzhi ka'i/ spyi bo'i gnas lngar= nas/ dpal chen 'dus pa dang*/ rta mgrin gnyis la/ rigs bdag snang (16)ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: gshin rje la/ rigs bdag rnam par snang mdzad kyis= yan lag la/ rigs bdag mi skyod pas dbu brgyan= bzhi kas/ snying ga'i 'od kyis=

nas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thing gsum/ zil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ dpal chen 'dus pa'i las byang gi hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings= tshig rkang bzhi/ gshin rje'i/ hūm̐: dbus phyogs mthing nag= tshig rkang bco brgyad/ rta mgrin gyi/ hūm̐: thugs rje'i lcags kyus= tshig rkang bzhi/ yang dag gi hūm̐: dmigs med mkha' ltar= dgu tshig rkang bzhi/ man tshig rkangabargyad/ phur pa la bdun tshig rkang bcu yod/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūṃ: yan lag= nas/ na ma ya dhīḥ bar/ phur pa la rang gi lha bskyed 'phros nas/ snying ga mgrin pa= nas lhug 'don gyis/ spyan 'dren mgor gzhan dang bstun nas/ thing gsum/ zil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ mthar/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ bar/ thams cad kyis lhan gcig tu las byang gi hūm̐: sgeg pa 'jigs rung= nas/ dma' mtho spel mas/ rang rgya bcas/ gar mchod/ glu mchod/ nyer mchod/ shab+da la zhi rol/ thing gsum/ zil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐: 'dod chags khrag chen= nas/ dug gsum mchod pa dang*/ sman mchod/ hūm̐: (17)hrī ṭhā: rtse len/ dbyings rig yab yum= lhug 'don/ bdud rtsi snying rje= nas/ rnga 'don/ dngos grub blang ba/ hūm̐: bha ga yangs pa'i= sogs/ gtor ma'i mchod pa/ ma hā b.ling+ta khā hi: de nas dpal chen tshe bdag rta mgrin/ yan lag bzhi la/ hūm̐: lcang lor bcas pa'i= sogs rak+ta'i mchod pa/ las byang gzhung ltar gtong chog phur pa tshang gi phur pa'i sgos chos rak+ta tshar gsum dgos pas/ hūm̐: dngos grub bar chad= sogs kyis pho nya bka' bsgos pa dang*/ hūm̐: bran dang bka' nyan= sogs/ dam can tha tshig sgrag hūm̐: dngos grub bar chad= sogs/ gnod byed kyi mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog pa'i phyir 'bul ba/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bar btang*/ de nas las byang gi hūm̐: yab dang yum gyi= sogs bdud rtsi gsang bsnan dang*/ hūm̐: rdo rje'i pad+mo'i= sogs sbyor sgrol mchod pa'i/ ta na ga na pū dza hoḥ

sum gcig zil/ 'jog med/ dpal chen 'dus pa'i/ hūm̐: mi sdug srin po'i= nas/ gar dgus sa gsum rnam gnon khyod la bstod: phyag rgya rgyas pa'i/ sku gsum dbu ni= nas/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan khyod la bstod: las byang gi chos nyid gcig la= nas/ bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: gshin rje tshe bdag gi hūm̐: mi gnas mi dmigs= nas/ mi mthun tshogs rnams rdul du rlag tu gsol: rta mgrin gyi las byang las (18)hūm̐: mi sdug srin po'i= nas/ gar dgus sa gsum rnam gnon khyod la bstod: 'phros/ be ḍūr sngon po= nas/ bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: yan lag las byang gi hūm̐: mi sdug srin po'i= nas/ gar dgus sa gsum rnam gnon khyod la bstod: 'phros/ bdag med phyogs bral= nas/ gau ri la sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di la tshig rkang nyi shu yod pas/ dpal chen gzhung las tshig rkang bzhi mang*/ phur pa'i/ hūm̐: sgeg pa dpa' ba= nas/ phra men pho nya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di tshig rkang nyi shu/ yang dag dang 'dra/ sum gcig zil/ bzhag so so'i bsnyen pa brgya re bzla/ zhwa bzhes/ pus mo g.yas btsug g.yon bslang*/ spos rdor dril 'dzin pas yo ga'i rtas/ hūm̐ las lce rdo rjer bsgom zhing*/ dbang gi spyi don las/ (Musical notes and signs here) rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams mchod dang sems can don// nangs par dkyil 'khor bri 'tshal bas// thugs kyis dgongs te gnang bar mdzod/ lan gsum/ zhi rol/ 'degs rgyas/ badz+rod tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ dril bsil yig brgya/ bum pa sta gon ni/ zhi rol/ bum par bgegs bskrad/ lha sngags rjod bzhin par bum rdzas blugs/ gtso bum dkyil 'khor dbus mañdzi'i khar 'khod/ las bum slob dpon mdun bzhag las byang mchod rlab// (19) hūm̐: dbyings nas= sogs/ shab+da la zhi rol/ sman gtor rak+ta'i sngags gsum re/ bdag 'jug dbang don rgya mtsho'i bum sgrub/

oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta= sogs nas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dril bcas/ bsdu rgya/ rdor gsor/ rig 'dzin thugs thig rtas/ hūm̐: dmigs med mkha' ltar= nas/ bzhi dril nang 'dren/ zhi rol/ dkar*/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang rgya/ hūm̐ḥ dngos su 'byor dang= sogs/ brjod med don bshags ltar yo ga bzhi dril/ shab+da/ bzhi rol/ dril stabs/ hūm̐: rdo rje glu ma'i= yo ga rigs lnga spyi phyag dril bsil/ gzungs thag blang*/ bdag bskyed kyi= sogs nas/ bum pa gang bar gyur: rtsa sngags la dbyangs gsal sbrel ba brgya/ mchod pa bsdus pa las byang gi hūm̐: nyer spyod lnga dang= nas/ shab+da= la zhi rol/ rigs lnga spyi phyag bcas yo ga'i rtas/ bstod pa sngar smos pa ltar/ yig brgya/ bdag 'jug gi oṃ āḥhūm̐: bum pa'i lha tshogs= nas/ dung chu bum par blugs/ las bum sgrub pa/ oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las= sogs nas/ shab+da= la zhi rol/ yo ga'i rtas rigs lnga'i spyi phyag bcas/ bstod par 'os pa= sogs rjod/ thugs kar nyi dkyil= sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mrita kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: rang rgya/ oṃ aḥhūm̐: bum lha bde stong= sogs kyis dung chos phul/ rdul phra (20) rab tu gyur: bar ro/ slob ma sta gon ni/ bla mas/ ji ltar bltams pa= dang yig brgyas khrus/ bgegs gtor dang*/ las byang bgegs bskrad/ bden stobs mthar/ dung chen/ (Musical notes and signs here) thing gcig zil/ zil/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ (Musical notes and signs here) las byang*/ srung 'khor/ kun slong bcos nas/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi= sogs la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du sngon 'gro sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ thugs rjes= sa gzhi spos chus= gdangs ma/ traṃ gu ru rat+na= bcas/ bla mas/ gsang sngags dngos grub= nas/ e ma dus gsum= rjes zlos/ bla mas/ e ma snod dang=

nas/ skyes bu gsum gyi= rjes zlos/ hoḥ bla ma kun bzang= rjes zlos/ slob ma rnams rdo rje sems dpar gsal mdzod: dri thig gnas gsum du yas mar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ āḥ.oṃḥ lce la hrīḥ rna bar trāṃḥ snying la ham̐'uḥ lag mthil gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis la hrīḥhrīḥ hrīḥhrīḥ snying gar hā: skye mched rnams rigs lngar byin gyis brlab bo: de nas so shing sbyin pa= dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i 'dun pas sngags 'di'i (21) rjes zlos dang bcas te tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du 'dor bar zhu: badz+ra ha sa ha: phyogs bzhi dbus dang= nas/ thob: dung zhal du gnas pa'i khyor chu: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa byin pas: chos thams cad nas= nas/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhe= sogs kyis bkye/ lag pa g.yas su= nas/ hūṃ las byung ba'i srung skud= nas/ oṃ sarba bu d+dha sa bcing / las chu dang rdo rjes 'grem/ badz+ra rak+ṣa= sogs/ ku sha/ oṃ badz+ra a mrita= stong pa'i ngang las= sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra tig k+ṣa na dhī: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ: gis bkye/ 'o do nub= sogs nas/ spro ba skyed pa ni: 'jig rten na= sogs/ skyed cig: de dag gis slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i chos rnams grub pa lags pas dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis= rjod/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor mdun/ las rdor nub/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī ā: thig skud brkyang*/ slob dpon nub/ las rdor shar du/ bh+rum̐ḥdzñā na ma da la hūm̐: rjod/ se gol bcas tshags thig dang po rgyab 'gros bcas g.yas bskor lho nas byang du sngags brjod bzhin 'gro/ rgyab 'gros med pa'i shar lho nas nub byang*/ lho bub nas byang shar/ 'di man rgyab 'gros thams cad la yod pas/ shar lho nas byang shar/ nub byang nas lho nub (22) nub byang nas byang shar/ shar lho nas lho nub/ nub nas shar du 'khod pas thig skud ldog las byang mchod pa/ hūm̐: nyer spyod= sogs/ shab+da= la zhi rol/

bstod pa gong smos ltar/ badz+ra muṃḥ tshon sna lngar 'bru bris pa/ oṃ hūm̐ swa āṃ hā las= sogs/ phra rab tu gyur: oṃ hūm̐ swa āṃ hāḥ rang rgya/ rnga rol bcas las byang gi bsngo smon/ hūm̐/ snang grags rig pa= lan gsum/ bkra shis/ hūm̐: gdod ma'i= nas/ rgyal bstan yun du gnas pa'i bkris shog: sum gcig thing gsum/ zil/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ bsod rnams 'di yis= sogs kyis tshogs grol/ thig tshon gzhung dang man ngag bzhin bya'o/ de nas rgyan bkod skabs su rab gnas bkra shis 'dod 'jo gtong tshul ni/ rnam bum/ thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga/ mchog dbang gsum/ tswa ru'i bza' ba/ khrus dkyil 'dab brgyad dbus su khrus gzhong me long*/ 'dab brgyad la khrus bum brgyad/ khrus ras na bza'/ khrus chal bzhi/ sku mnye/ dril phyis/ dung chu/ mthar nyer spyod skor bsham/ rab gnas me tog steng gzungs bum khar me long rten snying tshar bdun bris pa/ dung rung chu zhi drag sbyong ba/ gro zan/ zho zan/ chang bu/ yungs kar/ me/ chu/ til me chu/ gu gul/ mig thur sogs tsaka li rnams kyang 'tshogs par bya'o/ cho ga dngos la tshon lha la/ las byang gi (23) hūm̐: nyer spyod lnga dang= nas/ shab+da= zhi rol/ bstod pa gong smos/ badz+ra muṃḥ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i/ brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems/ yan brgyad/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ dkar bgegs/ las byang bka' bsgo/ srung 'khor/ brda sgo phyag dam bca'/ byin 'bebs/ mchod rlabs/ lha skyed/ dbang skur/ byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ 'dzab dmigs/ bzlas pa bcas sngar smos pa bzhin dang*/ rnam bum la dmigs nas/ rtsa sngags la dbyangs gsal dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swa hā: sbrel ba brgya/ rab gnas las/ lha tshogs rnams kyi= gang bar gyur: las byang ltar/ mchod pa/ zhi rol/ bstod pa/ lha tshogs rnams= nas/ thams cad pa'i= nas/ badz+ra a mri ta= nyer gcig me tog dam pa=

zhi rol/ de dag bsngags pa= badz+ra muḥye shes pa= nas/ phra rab tu gyur/ gzungs khrus bum pa rnams/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las= nas/ gang bar gyur/ gzungs bum steng gi me long gzungs thag slob dpon la phul/ ye rdar brgya/ mgo bskul bcas/ ye rdar = nyer gcig song tshe dung chus me long yig 'bru gzungs bum du bkru/ chu dung zhal du blug gtso bum/ las bum/ khrus bum brgyad/ rab gnas me tog bcas la blugs/ khrus bum brgyad kyi shar nas/ gzungs thag spo zhing*/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghan+dhe sna thu dzaḥ sogs bdun/ tri ma ru= bdun/ da dhi= bdun/ (24) pha la= bdun/ bru hi= bdun/ lā dza= bdun/ o ṣa dhi= bdun/ ma ṇi snā na= bdun/ gzungs thag shar bum la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ḥ brgya/ ru ru s+phu ru= nyer gcig yig brgya bdun/ rten snying gnyis/ dung zhal gyi dri chu/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: nyer gicag yungs kar khro bo'i tshogs kyi rang bzhin du gyur: bigh+nan ta kṛta= bcu gcig oṃ sum bha ni= bid+ya rwa dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa: nyer gcig oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa lī= nyer gcig hūm̐: nyer gcig tshogs theng gcig go bdag 'jug dbang don rgya mtsho ni/ ji ltar bltams pa= khrus gdangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi= dril bsil/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇa ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐: zhi rol/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ sa gzhi spos chus= tsag k+ṣu bhan+dha sa mig dar bcing*/ a khaṃ bī ras me tog gzung*/ e ma hoḥ bde gshegs snying po'i= khrus gdangs sam lhug mos bya ba 'og ma thams cad la 'gres/ bla na med pa'i= lha dang bla mar= las byang bzhin/ rdo rje slob dpon= bdag 'jug gi dus gsum dus med= bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du= oṃ sarba yo ga= 'di ni rdo rje'i= khrus gdangs/ hoḥ srid zhir mi gnas= a khaṃ bī ra= (25) oṃ na ma te= dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor= nas/ hūm̐: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la babs: khyad par bstan pa'i dus la babs: mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la babs: byin gyis rlob pa'i= dbang mchog skur ba'i= dngos grub stsol ba'i dus= mthu chen bdud 'dul bcom ldan 'das: byin chen byin phob= dbang chen dbang bskur= dngos grub mchog stsol= bdag cag las 'bras mchis par mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ a be sha ya= nas/ zhi rol/ rgyud gsum/ las rdor g.yab dar spos snod thogs pas dkyil 'khor tshogs pa bcas la bskor/

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: ho: smon pa'i yid kyis= khrus gdangs/ puṣ+pe sid+dhi= me tog bkram/ lhag lha= pra ti ghṛr+ṇa= spyi bor 'khod/ e ma hoḥ bde gshegs= khrus gdangs/ dzñā na tsak+ṣu= rdo rjes mig dbye tshul/ ho: phung po khams dang= sogs rdo rjes dkyil 'khor bstan tshul/ bdag mdun gyi= shab+da= zhi rol/ phung khams dag pa= yo ga rigs lnga spyi phyag nam mkha'i rdo rjes= thal sbyar/ khrus gdangs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa= nas/ bkra shis gang zhig= yo ga bzhi dril/ slob ma rdo rjes= nas/ dbang gdangs 'bring pos/ hūm̐: rnam shes phung po= sogs nas/ sngags la dril bsil dang*/ rdo rjes nang 'dren re thams cad la 'dra/ rigs kyi (26) bu khyod la= sogs dang*/ slob ma rin 'byung du gnas gyur: hūm̐: tshor ba'i phung po= sogs/ dbu rgyan gyon tshul/ rigs kyi bu khyod la= sogs dang*/ slob mar gnas gyur: hūm̐: 'du byed phung po= rdo rje phyar/ rigs kyi bu= sogs dang*/ slob ma don 'grub du gnas gyur: hūm̐: 'du byed phung po= dril bu g.yon pa'i mthe bong la skon/ rigs kyi bu= sogs dang*/ slob ma rnam snang du gsal bar gyur: hūm̐: ming gzugs phung po= sngags la rdor dril bsnol ma mgo thog dkrol/ rigs kyi bu= sogs dang*/ bum gdangs kyis/ hūm̐: bkra shis bum pa= rtsa sngags gsham/ badz+ra ka la sha= sogs dang*/ des rdul tshon= sogs dang*/ sa gzhi spos chus= dril bu g.yon pa'i sor rtser skon/ ho: chos rnams= dbang gdangs chung ba'am lhug 'don/ dus sbyor= 'dul ba= rdo rje btsun mo'i= des rdo rje btsun mo'i= sa gzhi spos chus= hūm̐: ka dag= dbang gdangs chung ba'am lhug 'don/ des rnam thar gsum= ho: so thar= sogs kyi rdo rje gsor/ ho: chos rnams thams cad= sogs kyis dril bu khrol/ thabs dang shes rab= sogs kyis 'khyud rgya/ de rnams yo ga'i rta la bskyon/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs= khrus gdangs= sa gzhi spos chus= bdag lus= khrus gdangs sam lhug 'don/

rang la thim par gyur bar rjod/ 'di'i tshe slob dpon gyis dbang rdzas rnams so sor blang*/ gdangs rnams lhug 'don sogs gang bder bya/ de nas rab gnas dngos la= (27) thams cad kyis zhwa bzhes/ las rdor pas phyag gsum/ zhwa lag tu/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams la zhi ba'i sgo nas sbyong ba gnang bar zhu/ zhwa gyon/ oṃ sarba big gha naṃ na maḥ sogs gsum/ gtor ma g.yas bskor gsum re bzed zhal du dor/ zhwa phab/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams la zhi drag phyed ma'i sgo nas sbyong ba gnang bar zhu: gyon/ oṃ sum bha ni= lan gsum/ mar me lcag g.yon bskor gsum re bzed zhal du dor/ zhwa phab/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams la drag po'i sgo nas sbyong ba gnang bar zhu: oṃ badz+ra kro dha= sogs/ spos 'gyed/ hūm̐: ye shes bskal pa'i= thugs thig gam kun rig bzhi dril/ gshegs su gsol: zhi rol/ steng gi nam mkha'= sogs/ shab+da= zhi rol/ hūm̐: 'jigs pa'i= yo ga bzhi dril/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang= gzhan du dengs shig: sum bha ni= bzed zhal g.yon bskor/ gral mdor/ na moḥrje btsun= dengs shig: sum bha ni= g.yon bskor/ sgo them steng*/ na mo rje btsun= gal ste= gtor ma phyir dor/ gul yungs dang bcas bgegs bskrad phebs/ rol tshig slob ma sta gon ltar/ zhwa phud las rdor phyag gsum/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten dang bdag cag yon mchod kyi byur dang skal ba ngan pa sbyong ba la thugs gtad par zhu: las rdor pas zhwa gyon/ lag g.yas gro zan chang bu/ g.yon zho zan chang bu/ g.yas su bskor/ oṃ (28) badz+ra a mṛta= lan gsum/ bzed zhal du dor/ lag gnyis kar yungs kar bzung g.yon bskor / hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ sarba pā paṃ= gsum/ dang pos mar me/ gnyis pas sa chu/ gsum pas gnyis kar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba pā paṃ= gcig chu mer blugs/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba pa paṃ= gcig me chu bzed zhal du blugs/ dkon mchog gsum la= sogs/ zhi rol gyis phyir dor/

las rdor phyag bcas/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i sdig pa sbyong ba la thugs gtad par zhu: zhwa gyon/ til gzung*/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i= sogs nas/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ= dor lugs gong ltar/ bdag dang= zhi rol gyis phyir dor/ de nas khrus ni/ thams cad zhwa bcas bzhengs/ las rdor kyis khrus dar phrag g.yon/ lag g.yon me long*/ de'i g.yas su 'dag chal dang po sil bcas thogs pa dang*/ g.yon du sku mnye sil bcas thogs pa gnyis kyang langs la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa= khrus kyi khang pa= khrus gdangs phyed rol/ khrus chal dang po/ a mṛ ta= sa byugs/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ bku mnye/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta= dril phyis/ bum pa dang pos/ ji ltar bltams pa= yo ga phyed rol/ de dag sku la= sku phyi/ khrus chal gdab/ a mṛ ta= oṃ hūm̐= bku mnye/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta= dril phyis/ bum pa gnyis pa/ 'di ni khrus mchog= phyed rol/ de dag sku la= khrus chal gnyis pa/ a mṛ ta= oṃ hūm̐= oṃ sarba= bum pa gsum pa/ 'di ni sbyinapa'i= (29) phyed rol/ de dag sku la= khrus chal gdab/ a mṛ ta= oṃ hūm̐= oṃ sarba= bum pa bzhi pa/ 'di ni tshul khrims= phyed rol/ de dag= khrus chal gsum pa/ a mṛ ta= oṃ hūm̐= oṃ sarba= bum pa lnga pa/ 'di ni bzod pa'i= phyed rol/ de dag= khrus chal gdab/ a mṛ ta= oṃ hūm̐= oṃ sarba= bum pa drug pa/ 'di ni brtson 'grus= phyed rol/ 'di dag= khrus chal bzhi pa/ a mri ta= oṃ hūm̐= oṃ sarba= bum pa bdun pa/ 'di ni bsam gtan= phyed rol/ de dag= khrus chal gdab/ a mri ta= oṃ hūm̐= oṃ sarba= bum pa brgyad pa/ 'di ni shes rab= phyed rol/ de dag= bum pa brgyad ka'i chu phyogs bsdus kyis/ sku mchog= rol/ dris byugs/ stong gsum kun tu= na bza' 'bul/ de nas de la= yo ga sems can gang dag= rang gdangs/ zhi rol lha khang kun la lha khrus la phebs/ phyir 'khor nas zhwa phud/ tshogs thengs gcig go

/oṃ ma hā shu n+ye ta= phyi nang gi= sogs nas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos 'gyed/ zhwa bcas bzhengs/ spyan 'dren gdangs chen/ na mo bde gshegs snying pos= bzhengs shig= mdo gdangs/ zhi rol/ rkang bzhi/ zhwa phud gral du bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni= mchod yon slob dpon gyis sbrengs/ shab+da/ zhi rol/ oṃ (30)badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs nas/ gnas bya'i= hūm̐/ dpal ldan= bum gdangs/ tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko ྅haṃ:/ bar/ 'og gi/ rang gi snying ga'i= sogs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= zhi rol/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang= mdo gdangs/ rigs lnga spyi phyag/ rdo rje can gyi= thal sbyar/ de bzhin gshegs pa= nas/ dbang gdangs che 'bring chung gsum/ yo ga mdo gdangs bcas skabs gang babs kyis/ rnam bum/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje dril bu/ rdor dril bsnol ma/ rdor dril so so ba/ rnam bum/ gsang thod/ rika tsag dbang bzhi pa/ de la mkhas pas bcos su med/ bar mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mang*/ bstod pa/ chos sku nam mkha'= nas/ mig thur/ sna drud/ rmang gzer/ thur dpyad/ tshem shing*/ zhi rol/ rū pa= rang rgya/ shab+da= bzhi bsnol/ ghan+dhe= nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: swa hā/ lan gsum/ rigs kyi= sogs dang*/ gnas bya'i rten= sogs/ su pra= nyer gcig oṃ hūm̐ hrībh+rum̐ khaṃ: nyer gcig ye dhar= nyer gcig byang chub snying por= ye dhar= zhi rol/ 'dir sgrub gzhung gi rgyan bkod ni/ spos dang rten rdzas thogs pas dkyil 'khor bskor/ zhwa bcas bzhengs/ rol ring dal myur spel mas 'khod/ zhwa phud/ gral du bzhugs/ hūm̐: ye shes 'bar ba'i= rdo rje gsor / hūm̐: shes rab chen po'i= 31) sogs nas/ ma hā ghaṇeḍa hoḥ dril bu bsil/ sil snyan gyis byin rlabs rgya rdung rgyas par bya/ de nas rab gnas kyi/ me tog dam pa= sho lo ka gnyis/ zhi rol/ zhwa bcas bzhengs/ ji srid sa chu= dang*/ phyogs bcu na= sogs/ lan gsum/ zhi rol/ dal myur spel mas lha khang thams cad rab gnas bya/

phyir 'khor nas/ zhwa phud/ tshogs thengs gcig go de nas mnga' dbul/ thub dbang mchod gnas= zhi rol/ maṇa ḍal so bdun/ kha bsgyur sems skyed sdom chog 'don dus ltar/ khor yug ri rab= nas/ sna bdun/ rtags brgyad/ ting 'dzin/ zhi rol/ 'dreg spyad/ chos gos/ lhung bzed/ zhi rol/ so ma/ dar/ rin po che/ nyer spyad/ zhi rol/ dur khrod/ gdan/ zhi rol/ khri sogs 'bul ba/ zhi rol/ srog shing*/ cod pan/ gdugs/ khri/ zhi rol/ tsā ru btegs la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo= sogs dang*/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog / maṇ+ḍal gdangs kyis btang*/ zhi rol/ ye dharma= phun sum tshogs pa= rang gdangs/ zhi rol/ cha gsum/ gsol ka/ dam can rgya mtsho'i= yan/ las rdor zhwa bcas gtor ma btegs/ badz+ra rak+ṣaḥhaṃḥnas/ rten mdun gzhag (32) me tog sprin mdzes= sogs/ zhi rol/ hūm̐/ ye shes sku mchog= sogs dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang= dbyangs gsal yig brgya lan gsum/ tshogs thengs gcig go/ bla mas/ bde gshegs lha tshogs= nas/ yan lag zungs: bar mchod phreng kun tu rgyu/ mchog gi me tog 'di dag ni= nas/ so sor bzhes: zhi rol/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bi shwa= zhi rol/ rkang bzhi/ stong pa'i ngang las= sogs nas/ dpa' bo chen po= sogs/ zhi rol/ me long ye shes= re re bzhin/ zhi rol ra ེ/ dngos su 'byor dang= nas/ 'byung gyur cig: zhi rol/ tshogs zhus/ thing gcig sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ dpal chen thugs las= sogs nas/ dam rdzas gyur: sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ dpal chen thugs las= sogs nas/ dam rdzas gyur: sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ 'og min= nas/ mchog dang thun mong= 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ sangs rgyas dam tshig= nas/ dngos grub stsol: sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ gang zhig= nas/ dag tshangs chen po'i= 'jam rol bzhag kha 'bud med/

na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi= nas/ da dgra= 'gugs rol/ (Musical notes and signs here) sbyar/ (Musical notes and signs here) sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ e las= sogs nas= gtubaḥ 'jam rol bzhag skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ na moḥ bde gshegs= lhug bh+yo bi shwa= thing gsum/ sil/ sum gcig 'jog med/ āḥrang byung lhun grub= nas/ rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la skyolaḥ bar/ bskul mtshams bcas/ mdor na rab 'byams= nas/ klong du āḥ sum gcig sil/ (33) bzhag rol/ hoḥ bla ma sogs drang lan/ hoḥ bdag lus= bsam lhun/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus= sogs/ thing gcig sum gnyis/ lhag ma 'di man chad 'jog yod yin/ kyaiḥ dang po phud kyi= sogs nas/ myur ba'i phyiraḥ lhag zhus/ oṃ āḥhūṃ pañtsa a mri ta hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon phung po zad mi shes pas nam mkha' gang bar gyuraḥ e a ral+li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= sogs thing gcig sil/ bzlog rol che ba yin pas/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ḥ rnam bdag rang bzhin zhi ba lasaḥ sogs/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ sil/ bzhag rol/ (Musical notes and signs here) gsol ka bkyag tshogs gnyis 'bras bu smin pa'i bkra shis stsol/ sum gcig sil/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ mi gnas nas/ phrin las mdzodaḥ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ dus gsum= nas/ phrin las mdzodaḥ sum gnyis/ bh+yoḥ tshogs dang bka' yi= nas/ phrin las mdzodaḥ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥdam sri= mi gtong ngo = sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ dung chen ṇir/ las byang mchod pa/ hūm̐ḥ nyer spyod lnga dang= thing/ sil/ bzhag bstod pa so so gong smos ltar/ hoḥ sngags kyi dngos grub= nas/ yig brgya lan gsum/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= hūm̐ḥ snod bcud lha dang= nas/ āḥ bcu dang bcas bzhag (34) slar yang= nas/ rak+ṣa hūm̐ḥ yig brgya/ rnga 'don gyis/ hūm̐ḥ snang grags= lan gsum/ bskul mtshams bcas/ hūm̐ḥ gdod ma'i= nas/ bkris shogaḥ sum gcig thing gsum/ sil/ bzhag rol/
bsod nams 'di yis= bzang spyod/ dngos grub rgya mtsho= gang du skyes pa'i= bskal mang gong nas= chos tshul 'di yang=

sogs spyi ltar gyis/ tshogs grol lo/ ༈ dngos gzhi'i nyin dang po la/ sngon 'gro ngag 'don gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lce dbang raṃ yig= nas/ a li bdun/ ka li bdun/ ye dhar bdun/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang par bgyi'o/ bla ma mkhyen/ snying dbus dad pa'i ge sar= sogs dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas= sogs dang*/ da res dmyal ba/ sogs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum dngos= lan gsum/ hoḥ sna tshogs= lan gsum/ āḥ bdag nyid tha mal= sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma yaḥ yig brgya nyer gcig mgon po= bdag ni= sogs dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'= sogs dang*/ satwa āḥbargya rtsa/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ nas/ sems bskyed sdom chog cha (35) tshang*/ rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog / bar/ phaṭaḥ lus gces 'dzin= nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ brgya rtsa/ phaṭaḥ yar mchod yul= nas/ e ma hoḥ rang snang lhun grub= sogs dang*/ hūm̐ḥ o rgyan= sogs dang*/ hrīḥ bdag lus= sogs dang*/ rje btsun= sogs dang*/ sid+dhi= brgya rtsa/ bdag la= sogs dang*/ sid+dhi= brgya rtsa/ e ma hoḥ rgya chad= sogs dang*/ gu ru'i smin mtshams nas= sogs dang*/ nam zhig tshe yi= sogs dang*/ bla ma'i thugs= sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin por che// bdag gi spyi bor= sogs nas/ thams cad phyam gcig sangs rgyas thob par shog /bar brjod/ hūm̐ḥ (Musical notes and signs here) o rgyan= lan gsum/ e ma hoḥ spros bral chos kyi= rang gdangs/ chos sku kun tu= 'di ltar mig gi= 'jam gling mdzes pa'i= brgyud 'debs/ kun bzang yab yum= rang gdangs dung chen/ sil snyan gyis/ bka' brgyad byin rlabs 'bring po/

mthar 'ur nang*/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ bzhag rang gi snying ga'i= brgyud 'debs gdangs kyis skyabs 'gro lan gcig lan gnyis pa nas lhug khrus gdangs kyis sems bskyed lan gcig lan gnyis pa nas lhug gsang 'dus rtsa gdangs kyis/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon= lan gcig lan gnyis pa nas lhug dzaḥhūm̐= sogs/ gang bdag 'dir gnas= yo ga zhi rol/ dkar/ sarba bigh+nan= 'di nas las byang bstod pa ma tshar bar du (36) sil snyan kho nas rdung srol yod pas/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med dal chags pas/ hūm̐ḥ nga ni spyi dpal= tshig rkang bka' bsgo dbyangs chen/ (Musical notes and signs here) gnod byed= nas 'bebs gdangs rnga shad can/ bzhin du= bshig sum gcig sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ḥ bdag nyid zhe sdang= rang gdangs/ tshig drug rnga gong ltar/ hūm̐ḥ mkhrig= rnga 'don/ mi gtong ngoḥ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐/ dpal chen 'dus pa'i= 'bebs gdangs rnga shad can/ brgyud gsum rol mo/ sil/ rkang bzhi/ rnga bzhag 'di'i mgo'i sum gnyis la bla ma dang*/ las rdor nas g.yab dar gcig brgyud gsum rol mor las rdor g.yab dar gyis dkyil 'khor bskor ba spyi ltar/ hūm̐ḥ dbyings nas yi ge= lhug shab+da la/ zhi rol/ dkar/ dung chen/ sman gtor rak+ta'i sngags gsum re/ hūm̐ḥ rang byung rig pa= tshig drug rang gdangs/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ thugs las= sogs nas/ ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla 'baraḥ sngags lhug thing gsum/ sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ḥ rang byung rgyu yi= rang gdangs/ tshig gnyis/ rnga gong ltar/ mnyam sbyor= man/ rnga 'don/ phyag rgya rgyas pa sbyor lugs dang*/ gshin rje/ tshe bdag rta mgrin/ yang dag phur pa bcas las byang dang sbrel lugs gong smos bzhin/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsalaḥ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ḥ rang las= man lhug 'don/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ (37) rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/

g.yon gyi phyag ga na ya / 'o ya lcags ga kyus ya / 'gugs ya ba' ི lcags kyus zungs nga la ya / 'e ya phur ra bas ya thob ye ba' ི gnod byed dgra ga bgegs ya / 'e ya rdul la / dul ya / rlog ga ba'i ba' ི/ 'o/ oṃ mo badz+ra ma ha kro dha pad+ma krau dhi/ sho re/ badz+ra/ ki li/ ki la ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa/ kā la ru pa/ karma raṃ/ ra dz+wa la raṃ/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rkang bzhi/ sbram/ re re tsa ba rtse med/ rkang gcig sbram/ sil/ bdun 'cham gnyis/ gong ltar gyis ldog sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog yod kyis/ hūm̐ḥ shar phyogs dkar mo= gdangs chen tshig gnyis/ sum gnyis/ tshags/ spyan rtsa= gdangs chen/ tshig gnyis/ sum gnyis/ dgu zlog drag rol 'bring pos/ bu yug thog 'bibs nas (45) btang*/ mthar dgu zlog rjes/ rkang bzhi/ sbram/ rtse med kyis thun brab tshogs pa bskor/ rang gral 'jags zin nas/ rkang gcig rgya gling*/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog yod/ hūm̐ḥ bskal pa srid pa'i gdangs chen tshig gnyis/ rnga gong ltar/ gzung 'dzin ru tra= nas rnga 'don mthar/ brgyud gsum rol mo/ sil/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ bzhag rol/ drag sngags so lnga zlo bzhin bzhugs/ nyin gung thog khar/ bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyis mchod pa phud skong tshar re/ nyin mtshan thun rnams la chags med rin po che'i bsang gsur spro na bya chog mtshan thun la/ gnam chos rtsa gsum las byang la/ dgongs gter bka' brgyad sbrel bas drag sngags me dpung mas thun gzung*/ thun mthar stong tshig sgrub chen gyi 'gros ltar/ ༈ nyin gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro ngag 'don/ sems bskyed sdom chog sbrel ma/ rol mo byin rlabs bsdus pa/ las byang nang so so'i lha sngags sbrel ma/ tho gso/ mdun bskyed/ las byang gzhung rgyug bdag 'jug gi bum skyed/ gsol ka cha tshang*/ cha gsum/ na rag skong bshags sam/ brjod me don bshags/ tshogs/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ bdag 'jug cha tshang*/ drang lhag gsol ka bskyang*/

skul chad brtan bro/ mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis/ skrad byin bcas/ 'don lugs nyin dang po bzhin la/ gdangs chen nyin (46) 'grig las byang gi ma rig ling tog= tshig gnyis/ spyan 'dren/ 'og min chos dbyings= tshig gnyis/ gsol ka nang*/ g.yas su sbyor ba'i= tshig gnyis/ 'khrugs skong*/ khyad par ma mo= tshig bzhi/ legs ldan/ mnyam med mthu mnga'= tshig bzhi/ skong bshags rdo rje thol glu'i/ bde gshegs snying pos= tshig gnyis sam bzhi/ ༈ nyin gsum pa la/ gsang 'dus byin rlabs/ byin 'bebs/ dpal chen 'dus pa'i= tshig gnyis/ bha ga yang pa'i gtor= tshig gnyis/ gsol kha'i/ g.yon du sgrol ba'i= tshang ma/ 'khrugs skong*/ yang gcig ma mo= tshig gnyis/ gza'/ dur khrod rab 'jigs= tshig gnyis/ skong bshags/ kun btags snang ba= tshig gnyis/ ༈ nyin bzhi pa la byin rlabs bsdus pa/ las byang*/ thugs las e yaṃ= tshig gnyis/ bstod pa/ mi sdug srin po'i= tshig gnyis/ gsol kha'i/ ting 'dzin sprul pa'i= tshig gnyis/ dpal ldan rang byung= tshig gnyis/ rang snang 'od gsal= tshig bzhi/ skong bshags/ rang byung lhun grub= tshig gnyis/ ༈ nyin lnga pa la/ phur pa'i byin rlabs/ las byang gi bh+ruṃ yig gnas 'gyur= tshig gnyis/ chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i= gdangs kun gzhi yid chos la 'geb pa tshig bzhi/ gsol ka'i/ snang srid kun gyi= tshig bzhi/ mnga' gsol/ skye med rdo rje= tshig gnyis/ g.yang 'gugs/ mkha' 'gro chen po sde lnga= cha tshang*/ skong bshags/ ka dag phyogs yan= tshig gnyis/ (47) nyin drug pa la/ byin rlabs bsdus pa/ 'og min gsang chen= tshig gnyis/ gsol ka'i 'khrugs skong*/ rdo rje phag mo= tshig gnyis/ sum cu rtsa gsum= tshig gnyis/ g.yu sgron ma'i/ rig 'dzin pad+ma= tshig bzhi/ dur khrod chen mo= cha tshang*/ rgyal po dgu brdung*/ skong bshags= bde stong klong yangs/ tshig gnyis/ ༈ nyin bdun pa la/ byin rlabs bsdus pa/ 'khrugs skong ga

ི 'jig rten 'das kyang= tshig gnyis/ legs ldan/ dpal chen thugs las= tshig gnyis/ dur khrod lha mo'i/ phyogs phyogs de ni= tshig gnyis gtong*/ sbyin sreg sa chog la/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg phur pa/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dpal chen sgrub gzhung*/ dbang gi sbyin sreg rta mgrin/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gshin rje/ mchog gi sbyin sreg yan lag go rim bzhin ser sbreng gis/ cha gsum/ sa lha dkar gtor/ a ka ro= yo ga bzhi dril/ rgyal ba shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde mngon par bcom pa'i tshe// dbang gyur sa yi lha mo khyod// gtor ma bzhes la sa 'di slong*/ 'o/ rnal 'byor (Musical notes and signs here) bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyugs dang*// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// badz+ra muḥ yi dam rtsa sngags brgya/ oṃ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum gyis thal mo sar bsnun/ oṃ ma (48) hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bha ba at+ma ko3 haṃḥ zhes brjod de/ slar rgyas pa/ dbang*/ drag po/ mchog zhi ba bcas/ sgrub khang du ldog nas/ dbus/ phyogs bzhi/ mtshams bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ gu ru shrī tsaṇa ḍa= grangs mang*/ tshom bu lha sta gon bzhin dgod do/ las byang mthar/ bkra shis 'khyil pa'i rol chen bya/ de nub spro na/ dngos grub dkyil chog spyi 'gro ltar/ ༈ nyin brgyad pa'i tho rangs khar tshig bdun brgyud 'debs/ rdo rje slob dpon/ byin 'bebs/ mchod rlabs/ rten dang brten bskyed/ dbang bskur/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs/ phyag mchod pa/ bstod pa yan phyi chog bzhin mdor bsdus dang*/ bsnyen pa rnams nyung tsam/ ye shes lha tshogs/ zhi rol/ gsol ka bsdus tsam/ tshogs grol/ las byang tshogs byin rlabs nas/ bsgral bstab yan/ thing*/ sil/ gdangs rol gyis/ las byang bskul pa/ gdangs tshig bzhi nas/ lhug sum gcig sil/ bzhag rtsa sngags la/ dharmā kā yaḥ saṃ bho kā yaḥ nirma kā ya tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ḥ zhes sbrel ba brgya'am nyer gcig

e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ brub khung= sogs nas/ nyul+le/ 'gugs pa gsum/ drag rol gyis/ phur thun tshom skul/ shar phyogs dkar mo= mthar/ sil/ dgra bgegs dpung bcom man gsum gyis nyul+le'i ling ga me hom du sregs/ sil/ sum gnyis/ kyis/ hūm̐/ bskal pa srid pa'i= sogs/ byin 'bebs (49) mthar/ brgyud gsum rol mo/ sil/ bzhag las byang gi hūṃ/ byin rlabs kun gyi= sogs/ dngos grub blang ba/ zhi rol dal myur spel mas dngos grub blang*/ las byang mchod pa zhi rol/ bstod pa yig brgya bcas/ dngos grub rdzas dang tshogs la rol/ bdag 'jug bsdus pa rig pa'i me tog dor ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃḥ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ḥ swa badz+ra sa ma swāḥ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hāḥ yo ga bzhi dril/ oṃ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugasaḥ yon tan phrin las rmad po cheḥ de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bsaḥ phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cigaḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma hoḥ gnang ba zhu ba ni/ oṃḥ rdo rje'i ye shes thob byed paḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyisaḥ pho brang snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ bdag gi slob ma 'jug par 'tshalaḥ bzod par mdzad de dgongs su gsolaḥ tshogs grol/ de nas dbang skur ba ni/ slob ma rnams sgo rgyab/ ji ltar sogs/ khrus/ yig brgya/ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha sa mig dar/ a khaṃ bī ras= me tog gtad/ kyeḥ khro bo mi bzad= rjes zlos/ khyed rnams su yin= dri ba la/ bla ma rdo rje= rjes zlos/ khyod ni snod mchog= gnang ba sbyin/ nang du 'khod/ yig brgya/ (50) bgegs gtor byin zhing bskrad/ rol mo sta gon ltar/ srung 'khor/ nam mkha' dang= sogs nas/ rim pa dbang gi cho ga laḥ sgrub sde bka' brgyad dpal chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por smin par bya ba skabs/ su bab pa thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi= sogs la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dngos gzhi'i dbang skur zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/

thugs rjes= snyim pa me tog= zhu len/ thun mong*/ khyad par sdom gzung*/ thams cad rnal 'byor= sems bskyed/ dam chu/ rigs pa'i sdom bzung*/ phyi 'jug ye shes dbab pa la zhi rol sum khug spos chog zhi rol/ brtan/ me tog dor/ spyi bor bcings/ mig dbye/ dkyil 'khor bstan/ dbang dngos/ las bu+um/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ rdor dril bsnol ma/ rdor dril so so ba/ rnam bum/ lha tsaka bcu/ gsang thod/ bzlas lung*/ rig tsaka shel rdo/ me long*/ glegs bam/ bkra shis/ dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag la/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi= byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor= phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du smin byed kyi dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du 'bul bar (51) bgyi'o/ thugs rjes= lus dbul/ dge bsngo/ bsod nams 'di yis= cha gsum/ btang nas grol/ ༈ sbyin sreg thig tshon sogs gzhung ltar/ dpal chen rtsa ba'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg 'don 'grigs la/ tshig bdun/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= oṃ badz+ra a mri ta= swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las= rdo rje gsor dril bu khrol/ 'khyud rgya/ hūm̐ḥ dbyings nas yi ge= yo ga shab+da/ zhi rol/ las byang ltar/ sman gtor rak+ta'i sngags/ hūm̐ḥ bigh+nan= nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ swa aṃ haḥ lan bdun/ badz+ra a a mri ta= swa bhā ba= stong pa'i ngang las= oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃḥ rol/ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ rlung g.yab rol/ thab kyi me yi= hūm̐ḥ dad pa dang ni= bum gdangs rol/ dzaḥhūm̐ḥ 'dir dbang gi sbyin sreg la mchod pa tshig bzhi yod/ oṃ ag+ne de ba= zhi rol/ hūm̐ḥ rin chen rigs las= rtsa gdangs/ phyag rgya cha gsum ltar/ bstod pa 'di sbyin sreg gzhan la med/ ji ltar bltam= khrus gdangs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas= me lha zhal= oṃ ag+ne ye swa haḥ lan bdun/ oṃ ag+ne de ba= rol/ oṃ ag+na ye swa haḥ

bdun/ ag+ne de ba= rol/ (52) oṃ ag+ne ye swahāḥ bdun/ oṃ ag+ne de ba= rol/ des dgang blugs nyer gcig sogs/ oṃ ag+ne de ba ri ṣi ha bya ka bya ma hā na ye de be= bdun/ bdag cag dpon slob = rol/ de 'dra bcu/ hūm̐ḥ tshangs pa 'jig rten= mdo gdangs/ phyed phyag cha gsum ltar/ yungs kar thab tu dor/ na moḥ rig pa'i= las rdor sgrub khang du byon/ oṃ swa bha wa= me lha'i lto ba= mdo gdangs/ lnga btegs/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇa ḍa laḥ spyan 'dren gdangs chen gyis/ hūm̐ḥ 'og min chos dbyings= tshig bzhi/ dung*/ rgya/ rkang*/ dkar/ ḍā/ rol ring nang tshom bu gdan drangs/ oṃ gu ru shrī badz+ra= rtsa sngags/ tshar grangs mang pos thab tu dor/ che mchog badz+ra thod phreng rtsalaḥ sogs nas/ mdo gdangs/ lnga btegs/ phyag rgya rgyas pa'i= ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsalaḥ hūm̐ḥ bla med mchog gi= shab+da= zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ ḍā/ rkang gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams= oṃ gu ru shrī badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dhā tsit+ta hūm̐ḥ bdun/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa= ye shes me dang= rol zhabs de 'dra gsum re dang dgang blugs nye ragacig bya/ de nas yam shing*/ mar khu/ rdzas sder brgyad la/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa= bcu/ ye shes mai dang= rol/ de 'dra brgya/ slar dgang blugs nye gcig rol gsum/ lha tshogs (53) rnams kyi= de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swa hāḥ rol/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ bu la ye swa hāḥ rol/ hūm̐ḥ rdo rje'i dam tshig= sogs/ sman/ me gtor/ rak+ta 'bul/ bstod pa rtsa gdangs/ rigs lnga spyi phyag lha tshogs rnams kyi= rtsa sngags la/ sarba sid+dhi= sbyar ba nyer gcig badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= rol/ chos nyid gcig la= rtsa gdangs rigs lnga spyi phyag ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ gtso bos nus pa ma mchis pa// 'dir na bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ yig brgya/ lha tshogs rnams sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la gshegs par gyuraḥ

rol dal myur spel ma'i nang tshom bu yar drangs/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa rang nyid la thim par gyuraḥ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la dz+wa laḥ gcig oṃ ag+ne de ba= lan brgyad/ rol/ de 'dra bcu/ badz+ra taṃ bu= rol/ badz+ra wa s+t+ra= rol/ oṃ ag+ne de ba ri ṣi ar+ghaṃ= rol/ nyis btegs/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod (54)cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ phyed phyag rtsa gdangs yan/ oṃ ag+ne= gcig dril nyis brdung*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma (Musical notes and signs here) 'di bzhes laḥ rnal 'byor= zhi rol/ rtsa gdangs kyis/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gtso bos nus pa ma mchis pa// 'dir ni bya min gang byas pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs// dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ bla ma yi dam= dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa'i= bkra shis/ zhi rol sum khug bya'o/ rgyal ba kun gyi= sogs kyis bsdu/ tshogs grol/ khrom dbang dgos na/ chags med rin po che'i bka' brgyad dbang gis skur/ de nas lhag ma gteng dus lhag ma brtson 'dzin dang bcas pa lhan cig phul/ gsol ka bkyag bskul chad brtan bro/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa rjes/ rdul tshon la/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub rtsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muṃḥ hūm̐ḥ snod bcud lha dang= sogs/ bsdu ldang*/ yig brgya bcas/ ser sbreng gis rgyal tho bsdu sar/ 'don lugs tho 'dzugs dus ltar la/ dri za'i gdon rnams mtshams chod cig zhes pa lta bu'i (55) tshig rkang tha ma rnams/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ zhes kha sgyur/ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod/ sgo byang la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ= thing gcig sil/ bzhag kro dha ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wa ra a kā ro=

gsum/ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod la nang du ldog gral du 'khod/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor mdun skam pa'i rgyas/ khro bcu'i phur pa 'og nas rim par blang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī la ya ut+ki la ya sarba ki la ya badz+ra dha rod a dzñā sa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā/ lan bcu/ phur rtse 'o mas bkru/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sa dha ni swahā/

rdul tshon la re ga gsum bris nas bsdu/ a kā ro= zhi rol/ de nas/ rgyal tshab pas gtong thun bcas thams cad kyis zhwa bzhes/ mar me'i smon lam zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba las byung ba/ hūm̐: rig pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor duḥ rig gdangs slob dpon gnyen gyis dbu bzung nas: rig rtsal lu gu rgyud kyi mched lcam rnams: rig stong rjen pa'i gshis las mi 'da' shog: nam zhig gdod ma'i lhums su zhugs pa'i tsheḥ ma rig (56)'khrul pa'i g.yang sar mi gtong zhing: 'khor ba lu gu rgyud du mi lhung bar: 'khor ba ka nas dag pa'i gzhi dbyings cher: gzhi snang gzhon nu bum skur grol bar shog: gal te gdod ma'i sa la ma grol na: lhun grub zhi khro'i snang ba 'char ba'i tshe: rang snang ye shes chen po ngo 'phrod nas: bar do longs spyod rdzogs skur grol bar shog: ye gdangs gsal stong dag pa gnyis ldan che: stong gzugs dwangs ma lnga ldan rigs lnga'i zhing: rang snang rnam dag 'og min zhing khams su: dag pa gsum gyi 'khor la chos ston shog: gal te longs sku'i zhing du ma grol na: rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams lnga tshom dang: rigs 'dus rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang cher: skad cig nyid la brdzus te skyes nas kyangaḥ rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i gral du smin par shogaḥ theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse yo ga gsum: de las rnam par 'das pa man ngag sde'i: dgongs klong bya rtsol bral ba'i gshis lugs suḥ blos byas bden zhen dri ma dag par shogaḥ rang rig gdod nas dag pa'i rang mdangs su: rang rtsal bdun brgya nyer lnga zhi khro'i (57)sku: snang la rang bzhin med pa'i dal bkram ste: ye shes mthong ba dag pa'i mar me 'bulaḥ nyon mongs 'khor ba'i chos la mun pa sangasaḥ bzang zhen shes bya'i smag rum bsal nas kyangaḥ rjod med lhag mthong ye shes chen po'i klongaḥ nyams rtogs rig pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs par shogaḥ phung po lnga dag rigs lnga'i zhing du grolaḥ

'byung lnga gnas dag rigs kyi yum lngar sminaḥ rnam shes dbang dag sems dpa' brgyad du grolaḥ snang bzhi zad nas 'ja' lus 'grub par shogaḥ dran rig 'od gsal chen po'i mar me 'diḥ rgyun chad med par sbar ba'i bsod nams mthusaḥ las rlung bag chags mun pa drung phyungs nasaḥ kun bzang dgongs klong phyam gcig grol bar shogaḥ zhes rjes zlos grub nas/ rnga rol bcas las byang gi bsngo smon/ hūm̐ḥ snang grags rig pa= lan gsum/ bkra shis/ gdod ma'i mgon po= mthar/ sum gsum/ thing gsum/ sil/ bzhag rol/ slar byang 'dren bzhengs te/ sngags smon rdo rje'i rgya mdud/ bla ma yi dam/ gdangs chen/ tshig bzhi man rtsa gdangs/ bkra shis/ phun sum tshogs pa= tshigs bcad gsum/ che ba'i che mchog= tshig bcad drug gi rjes su bkra shis dga' bskor spyi ltar rjes/ rgyal ba sras bcas= tshig bcad lnga/ nyin mo bde legs= tshig bcad bzhi 'phros/ rol chen gyis zhi rol (58) brgyud gsum bya/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo smon rgyas par byas te grol/ ༈ phyi nyin rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs skong rjes/ ser sbreng gis rdul tshon chu bor sbyong tshul 'don cha ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= rol/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rgya mtsho rin po che dang me tog gis gang ba'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa'o/ snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu chen brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'dab ma brgyad la 'khod pa ni stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can ldan pa smad sbrul du 'khyil zhing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'khor dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/

oṃ badz+ra satwa aṣ+ṭa nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ= rol/ gdengs ka'i nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shingaḥ bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam (59) mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ oṃ/ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyal bu// 'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no// lha mo lha mo chen po dngaḥ zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug cheḥ dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*// sog ma med dang hu luṇa ḍa// dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' bo// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*// tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*// gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*// lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang*// tshi li chen po rnam dag go /oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa a gats+tsha a gats+tsha ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta sarba bhurbu wa phruṃ phuḥswa hā/ gong bzhin mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor= sogs/ klu yi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdul tshon rin po che'i rang bzhin 'di rnams bdag gir mdzad nas mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang khyad par du sa phyogs 'di dag tu bde legs kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'phel zhing rgyal par mdzad du gsol/ (60) oṃ/ phun sum tshogs pa= rol gsum/ yig brgya/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rig oṃ/ khyed kyis= a gats+tsha a gats+tsha swa bha wa nan/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ rol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ rdo rje sems dpa' rang la thim par gyur/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyidaḥ sogs rjod/ rdul tshon chur byo pa'i snod du chus bkang ste phyir ldog

sgrub khang du bslebs nas/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sa dha ni swa hā/ spyan ma'i sngags kyis chur gtor/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ bkra shis/ zhi rol brgyud gsum/ bsngo smon rgyas par byas pas legs par grub bo/ rdul tshon chur sbyong ba/ ma phebs sngon du khang steng nas du ba mthong grol dang*/ chu kha nas chu mthong grol bya na/ bla ma dgongs 'dus bzhin no/ zhi rgyas dbang drag mchog gi sbyin sreg gtong lugs zur du gsal/ sgrub sde bye ba'i yang zhun 'das rigs lnga/ tshogs su bsgrubs pas 'brel tshad 'gro ba kun// mthong sgom mthar lam mthar phyin he ru ka'i// go 'phang tshe (61) 'di nyid la 'grub gyur cig /ces pa dpal rig pa 'dzin pa dga' rab rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa la spyod pa'i 'og min gnyis pa brda go lha ri 'od gsal gling gi rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdes/ snyigs dus kyi rgud pa gso ba'i ched du tshogs sgrub chen po ji srid nyi zla'i bgrod pa ma 'byung gi bar du phyag bstar ba'i gsol 'debs su rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o// (62)
